notes.title: Difficulty Settings update
notes.content:
NOSTOI HP system has been updated.

The amount of lives on Easy Difficulty has been increased from 5 to 10. Now, playing the game on this difficulty shouldn't be frustrating... most of the times ;)

The amount of lives on Medium Difficulty has been increased from 3 to 5.

The amount of lives on Hard Difficulty is still 1.

Thank you and good luck with the game.
